settings.ADAPTERS_DEFAULT_INTERVAL_SECON: Fallback poll interval for any adapter lacking its own ADAPTERS_<NAME>_INTERVAL_SECONDS.
settings.DISPATCHER_INTERVAL_SECONDS.des: How often dispatcher polls radiobeacon.db for new items to dispatch.
settings.DISPATCHER_CONSUMER_NAME.label: Consumer name
settings.DISPATCHER_CONSUMER_NAME.descri: Logical consumer name — its own row in dispatcher_state tracks its progress.
settings.DISPATCHER_MQ_HOST.label: MQTT host
settings.DISPATCHER_MQ_HOST.description: Broker host for dispatcher's audit-event publishing. Defaults to localhost; set to an empty string to disable publishing entirely.
settings.DISPATCHER_MQ_PORT.label: MQTT port
settings.DISPATCHER_MQ_PORT.description: Broker port for dispatcher's audit-event publishing.
settings.DISPATCHER_MQ_QOS.label: MQTT QoS
settings.DISPATCHER_MQ_QOS.description: QoS level for dispatcher's published events.
settings.ACTIONS_MQ_HOST.label: MQTT host
settings.ACTIONS_MQ_HOST.description: Broker host actions subscribe to and publish on.
settings.ACTIONS_MQ_PORT.label: MQTT port
settings.ACTIONS_MQ_QOS.label: MQTT QoS
settings.ACTIONS_MQ_RECONNECT_BACKOFF_SE: Seconds between actions' MQTT reconnect attempts.
settings.ACTIONS_CHUNK_SUBSCRIBE_TOPIC.d: MQTT topic ChunkAction subscribes to — actions.ai's own output, not item.dispatched directly, so chunk always runs after ai has settled. ChunkAction falls back to this exact value in code, so chunking works with no config; override only to re-wire the pipeline, or set empty to disable the action.
settings.ACTIONS_CHUNK_OUTPUT_TOPIC.desc: MQTT topic ChunkAction publishes item.chunked events to.
settings.ACTIONS_CHUNK_MAX_CHARS.label: Max chars per chunk
settings.ACTIONS_CHUNK_MAX_CHARS.descrip: Max characters per chunk (word-boundary-safe) — a ceiling, not a fixed size: dynamically clamped down further at runtime if the current beacon callsign/destination/prefix/suffix would otherwise risk an assembled AX.25 frame exceeding its ~256-byte limit. Applies live — no restart needed.
settings.ACTIONS_AI_ENABLED.label: Enabled
settings.ACTIONS_AI_ENABLED.description: Enables/disables AiAction entirely. Applies live — no restart needed.
settings.ACTIONS_AI_SUBSCRIBE_TOPIC.desc: MQTT topic AiAction subscribes to. AiAction falls back to this exact value in code, so the pipeline runs with no config; override only to re-wire it, or set empty to disable the action.
settings.ACTIONS_AI_OUTPUT_TOPIC.label: Output topic
settings.ACTIONS_AI_OUTPUT_TOPIC.descrip: MQTT topic AiAction publishes to — ALWAYS, once it has a valid source/item_id, even when it decided there's nothing to summarize (a summarized:false marker) — actions.chunk subscribes here so it always runs after ai has settled.
settings.ACTIONS_AI_PROVIDER.label: Provider
settings.ACTIONS_AI_PROVIDER.description: Which LLM provider to call. Required once AI is enabled.
settings.ACTIONS_AI_CLAUDE_MODEL.label: Claude model
settings.ACTIONS_AI_OPENAI_MODEL.label: OpenAI model
settings.ACTIONS_AI_OLLAMA_MODEL.label: Ollama model
settings.ACTIONS_AI_OLLAMA_HOST.label: Ollama host
settings.ACTIONS_AI_OLLAMA_HOST.descript: Ollama server host URL, used when provider=ollama.
settings.ACTIONS_AI_MAX_CHARS.label: Max input chars
settings.ACTIONS_AI_MAX_CHARS.descriptio: Skip-summarization threshold on input length — items at or under this length aren't summarized (extracted_contents is still copied into items.summary verbatim). Matches ACTIONS_CHUNK_MAX_CHARS's default exactly. Not used for voice length — see BEACON_VOICE_MAX_CHARS.
settings.ACTIONS_AI_PROMPT.label: Prompt template
settings.ACTIONS_AI_PROMPT.description: Global str.format-style override of the default summarization prompt. Any of an item's mapped adapter attributes can be referenced as a placeholder: {source}, {item_id}, {extracted_title}, {extracted_contents}, {summary}, {url}, {event_key}, {type}, {subtype}, {policy}, {source_date_time}, {fetched_at}, {captured_at}, {rawdata}, plus the source's display name and site URL as {source_name} / {source_url} — an unknown placeholder just renders blank. A single adapter can override this further via its own 'AI prompt override' field on the /config/adapters form.
settings.ACTIONS_AI_EVENT_INCLUDE_PROMPT: When on, the fully rendered prompt sent to the provider is attached to each item.ai_settled event and its action.ai.executed audit row (visible on /audit). Off by default — the prompt embeds the item's full text, so it bloats every event, log line, and audit row. The event/audit row already carry a `reason` (on skips) and `provider`/`model` (on success) regardless of this setting.
settings.ACTIONS_CONTENT_READY_POLL_INTE: How often the content_ready watcher scans for items where both chunk and AI have finished, to publish item.content_ready.
settings.ACTIONS_CONTENT_READY_OUTPUT_TO: MQTT topic item.content_ready events are published to — the single trigger beacon subscribes to for both voice and frame.
settings.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.label: Anthropic API key
settings.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Used by AiAction when ACTIONS_AI_PROVIDER=claude. Never displayed once saved — leave unchanged to keep the current value.
settings.OPENAI_API_KEY.label: OpenAI API key
settings.OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Used by AiAction when ACTIONS_AI_PROVIDER=openai. Never displayed once saved — leave unchanged to keep the current value.
settings.DISPLAY_TIMEZONE.label: Display timezone
settings.DISPLAY_TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone used to convert stored UTC datetimes for presentation only (UI pages, beacon's transmitted {date} placeholder) — never affects storage, which stays UTC. Applies live — no restart needed.
settings.UI_PAGE_SIZE.label: Page size
settings.UI_PAGE_SIZE.description: Rows per page on the items list, audit log, and Developers item browser.
settings.UI_DEV_TOOLS_ENABLED.label: Developer tools enabled
settings.UI_DEV_TOOLS_ENABLED.descriptio: Enables the /dev section (raw item add/edit/delete, dispatch-state reset, a read-only SQL runner) — a larger attack surface than the rest of this auth-less app. False 404s every /dev/* route and hides its nav link. Applies live — no restart needed.
settings.UI_DASHBOARD_REFRESH_SECONDS.de: How often the dashboard's browser-side auto-refresh re-polls. 0 disables it.
settings.UI_DASHBOARD_TX_STREAM_URL.desc: HTTP(S) URL of a live audio stream carrying SvxLink's transmit audio — e.g. an ffmpeg/Icecast capture of an ALSA loopback or a PulseAudio monitor (see documentation/svxlink-txqueue-SETUP.md). When set, every open dashboard plays it while the rig is keyed (ON AIR monitor), with a per-viewer mute toggle. The UI proxies and fans it out, so bind the stream to localhost. Blank disables it. Applies live — no restart needed.
settings.UI_DEFAULT_CONSUMER_NAME.label: Default consumer name
settings.UI_DEFAULT_CONSUMER_NAME.descri: Consumer name prefilled on the item detail/edit rearm form. When unset, falls back to the current effective DISPATCHER_CONSUMER_NAME.
